components.css: .ds-catalogue{width:100%;border-collapse:separate;border-spacing:0;color:#171b24;font:400 12px/1.5 Manrope,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-catalogue td{padding:4px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid #e3e1dc;vertical-align:middle}.ds-catalogue td:first-child{min-width:190px}.ds-catalogue tr[data-selected=true] td{background:#fcf6e9;box-shadow:inset 0 1px #d4a72c,inset 0 -1px #d4a72c}.ds-catalogue tr[data-selected=true] td:first-child{box-shadow:inset 1px 0 #d4a72c,inset 0 1px #d4a72c,inset 0 -1px #d4a72c}.ds-catalogue tr[data-selected=true] td:last-child{box-shadow:inset -1px 0 #d4a72c,inset 0 1px #d4a72c,inset 0 -1px #d4a72c}.ds-catalogue tr:hover td{background:#faf8f2}.ds-row-name{display:flex;align-items:center;width:100%;min-width:0;text-align:left;border:0;padding:0;background:transparent;color:inherit;font:inherit;cursor:pointer}.ds-row-name strong{display:block;font-size:12px;line-height:1.25;font-weight:750;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-row-name small{display:block;color:#586071;font-size:10px;line-height:1.2;margin-top:1px}.ds-row-name:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #98701a;outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview:
This file records Offerings as an ordinary extension of the existing NEXG merchant workspace. It is scoped to this folder and does not replace global product or design guidance. The approved general concept fixes the catalogue/editor composition. The implementation retains the dark shell, cream workspace, white editor and gold actions.

The merchant scans a catalogue, selects an offering and edits the applicable contract. One composition adapts to 128 specialty bindings and 18 editor contracts. Compact controls and internal scrolling keep long records usable without reducing the whole form to one static view.
keyCharacteristics: A larger catalogue column beside a selected editor.
A serif page title above compact Manrope controls and table text.
Fine rules, explicit selection and visible editor actions.
Text that distinguishes publication, source ownership and preview state.
dos: Do preserve the existing merchant shell and the catalogue/editor relationship.
Do keep long content reachable through internal scrolling, tabs and disclosures.
Do keep preview scope, source ownership and current capacity explicit in text.
donts: Don't turn this scoped record into a replacement global visual identity.
Don't equate Published with available stock or confirmed resource readiness.
Don't treat reused demo imagery or browser captures as real merchant listing evidence.
